[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for proper form and technique for squats include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly outward.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Keep back straight, chest up, and shoulders relaxed.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Lower body down into a squat, keeping weight in heels.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Keep knees in line with toes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Keep chest up and shoulders relaxed.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Pause at the bottom, then stand up.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Breathing: Inhale at the top, exhale as you descend, inhale as you stand up.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for proper form and technique for deadlifts include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, toes straight or slightly outward.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Hold the barbell with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Keep back straight, chest up, and shoulders relaxed.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Lift the barbell close to shins, avoiding jerking.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Keep hips and knees in line, weight evenly distributed.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Keep the bar
